# Clickmeeting

ClickMeeting is a cloud-based online meeting and webinar platform that enables businesses and individuals to host virtual meetings, webinars, and training sessions.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/clickmeeting/.

## Actions

- **Create Conference**: Create a new conference.
- **Create Contact**: Create a new contact in your clickmeeting account.
- **Delete Conference**: Delete a specific conference.
- **Delete Recording**: Delete a specific recording for a conference room.
- **Delete Recordings**: Delete all recordings for a conference room.
- **Generate Autologin URL**: Generate an autologin url for a conference participant.
- **Generate Session PDF Report**: Generate a pdf report for a specific session.
- **Get Chat Details**: Retrieve details of a specific chat session.
- **Get Chats**: Retrieve a list of all chat sessions.
- **Get Conference Details**: Retrieve details of a specific conference.
- **Get Conference Files**: Retrieve files associated with a conference.
- **Get Conference Sessions**: Retrieve a list of sessions for a conference room.
- **Get Conference Skins**: Retrieve a list of available conference room skins.
- **Get Conferences**: Retrieve a paginated list of conference rooms.
- **Get File Library**: Retrieve a list of files in the file library.
- **Get Phone Gateways**: Retrieve a list of available phone gateways.
- **Get Recordings**: Retrieve recordings for a specific conference room.
- **Get Registrations**: Retrieve registrations for a conference room by status.
- **Get Session Attendee Details**: Retrieve details of a specific session attendee.
- **Get Session Attendees**: Retrieve the attendee list for a specific session.
- **Get Session Details**: Retrieve details of a specific session in a conference room.
- **Get Session Poll Details**: Retrieve details of a specific poll conducted during a session.
- **Get Session Polls**: Retrieve a list of polls conducted during a specific session.
- **Get Session Q&A History**: Retrieve the q&a history for a specific session.
- **Get Session Recording Details**: Retrieve details of a specific recording for a session.
- **Get Session Recordings**: Retrieve a list of recordings for a specific session.
- **Get Session Registrations**: Retrieve registrations for a specific session.
- **Get Session Survey Details**: Retrieve details of a specific survey conducted during a session.
- **Get Session Surveys**: Retrieve a list of surveys conducted during a specific session.
- **Get Time Zone List**: Retrieve a list of available time zones.
- **Get Time Zone List by Country**: Retrieve time zones for a specific country.
- **Ping API**: Check api service status.
- **Register Participant**: Register a participant for a conference room.
- **Send Invitation**: Send invitation emails to a clickmeeting conference.
- **Send Invitation Email**: Send invitation emails to participants of a clickmeeting conference.
- **Upload File**: Upload a new file to the file library.
